description: This PHP source file provides the frontend interface and JavaScript logic for the Network Diagnostic Tools page in a web administration panel. It includes HTML forms for testing network connectivity, checking IPv4/IPv6 addresses, and performing traceroutes, along with embedded scripts for validating inputs, making Ajax requests, and displaying results.

methods.name: showTracerouteDialog
methods.description: Displays a modal dialog with traceroute results, allowing the user to close it.

methods.name: checkTraceError
methods.description: Evaluates traceroute status results, shows error dialogs if necessary, and updates the UI.
